summary: REQ-1 appears partially implemented (backend cost set to 50), and global background styling is applied in App.tsx via a new useAppBackground hook. However, the diff summary does not provide enough evidence that frontend streak-freeze UI text was updated everywhere, that badges are displayed/persisted, or that purchased themes/background selection is persisted via the backend as required. Several unrelated changes (rank rename + migration, placeholder App content) were introduced without being requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Change the Streak Freeze price to 50 coins everywhere it is enforced and displayed (backend purchase validation and all frontend UI text).
missing_requirements.reason: Backend constant is shown as 50, but the diff summary does not show purchase validation logic and error message text mentioning 50 coins, nor does it show Timer section UI labels/helper text updated to 50 coins. Modified TimerSection.tsx is listed but its content is not shown in the summary, so this cannot be verified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Display purchased/earned badges on the user profile, including badges earned via streak milestones and badges purchased with coins, and ensure they persist across reloads/logins for the same user.
missing_requirements.reason: ProfileSection.tsx is modified and a new useCosmeticsInventory hook was added, but the diff summary does not include any code showing a dedicated badges area/grid, mapping streak milestone badge tier/state into displayed badges, or backend persistence of purchased/earned badges.
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated; no badge persistence evidence shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: Make purchased themes apply as the app background (global app background), using the user's currently selected purchased theme, persisting across reloads/logins for the same user.
missing_requirements.reason: Global background styling is applied in App.tsx, but persistence appears to be implemented via localStorage keyed by principal rather than via backend state, and the diff summary does not show any linkage between 'purchased themes' and the selected background (e.g., verifying ownership, selecting from purchased themes, persisting selection in backend).
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated; no theme selection persistence evidence shown)
